names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 6 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети мученици Конон отац и Конон син.“, with the rank word мученици left off and Свети, which is not a rank. The heading distinguishes the two men only as father and son, so the bare forename is all it gives either of them; the kinship is in this folder's English name, where this corpus puts such clauses, and not in the Serbian form.

Read out of the title on the name link behind the line for 6 марта ст. ст., name page 1264, «Конон Иконийский, Младший (сын), прмч.», with the grade word left off; the day's own line declines the forename and distinguishes the two men only by «и сына его». The whole form is kept for the reason given on his father's folder. `.tmp/foldchk.py` reports no folder holding this form, and `.tmp/sr-foldpred.mjs` no other holder of the key it folds to.

death.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 6 March: „Чесно пострадали 275. године.“ The same three sentences also say they suffered „У време Дометијана“ — in the time of Dometian — without saying who Dometian was; the page calls him neither emperor nor governor, and nothing was read that would identify him, so the year stated is recorded and the name is left as the page leaves it. The entry makes this one seventeen years old at his death and gives no year for his birth.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 6 марта ст. ст. — «Прмчч. Конона и сына его Конона (270-275).»

attestations.note: One line for the two of them, and the first life either folder has carried: both were already folders, made off the Охридски пролог for this same day-number, which gives each of them the bare «Конон» under one rank word and nothing else — the fold the gate reports for that form is read in this batch. **The grade differs between the two calendars and nothing is changed in `types` on that account**: the Serbian book made them `martyr`, and this line grades them прмч., venerable-martyrs, which is the grade the life behind it argues for, since they are monks of a monastery at Iconium. The span on the line, 270-275, is the reign of Aurelian and is the span this folder already records. He is the younger, name page 1264 against the father's 1265, and the life behind the line is the only source read that gives him a rank of his own: «семнадцатилетний сын мученика - диакон Конон», which is why `office` now says Deacon.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for 6 martie, which is the page for this menologion number — not 19 martie, which merely shares his civil date in 2026.

Not checked: saint.gr's εορτολόγιο for 6 Μαρτίου, which is the page for this menologion number. The corpus holds six other folders for men of this name and none of them is on this menologion day, and none of the six is a youth of seventeen martyred with his father.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 19.03.2026 (6. март ст. ст.) — „Свети мученици Конон отац и Конон син.“

attestations.note: The day's third and last entry, three sentences long. The heading names two people, so it is an enumerated company of two and therefore two folders, and it is quoted whole by both of them. The Prologue is the only one of the four calendars read for him.
